_note: Every repo the session queue may start work in. Read by tools/dispatch.py: an entry for a repo not listed here is flagged and never started. 'resources' are things outside the repo that two sessions must never change at once; an entry whose migration is not 'none' holds its repo's db resource automatically, and any entry can claim a resource by naming it in owns (for example db:idea-supabase). Rules files, ledgers and apply paths were read from each repo on 2026-10-17; a session still reads the repo's own rules file first, because that file wins.
